title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Aurora University
description: Navigate the late-night food landscape near Aurora University with these reliable spots for study breaks and post-event meals.

cards.title: Spartan Spot
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Dining at Stephens Hall
cards.notes: Visit Stephens Hall for late-night Asian-style bowls and grilled sandwiches. It serves as a primary social hub for students seeking a meal without leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: The Spartan Spot is a central on-campus dining location offering customizable bowls and sandwiches until 10:00 PM on select weeknights.
cards.evidence_claim: The Spartan Spot is located in Stephens Hall and has been documented to serve dinner items like K-Ramen and power bowls with hours extending to 10:00 PM on Mondays and Tuesdays.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM on Mondays and Tuesdays; hours vary by day and academic calendar.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Lake Street
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Drive-Thru Near Campus
cards.notes: Head to Lake Street for a quick drive-thru run. This location is a staple for students needing a meal in the early morning hours.
cards.short_summary: A reliable fast-food option located less than a mile from campus, offering drive-thru service until 4:00 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 1204 N Lake St in Aurora is open until 4:00 AM for drive-thru service.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Aurora, IL - 1204 N Lake St

cards.title: McDonald's on Lake Street
cards.subtitle: Midnight Fast Food Stop
cards.notes: Stop by this nearby Lake Street location for a midnight snack. It is one of the closest off-campus options for students living in residence halls.
cards.short_summary: A convenient fast-food destination located just north of the university campus, open until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's at 1023 N Lake St in Aurora operates until 12:00 AM daily.

cards.title: Denny's
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Diner Near Fox Valley
cards.notes: Drive to Fox Valley for a full diner menu at any hour. This 24/7 spot is ideal for late-night study groups or early morning breakfast runs.
cards.short_summary: A classic 24-hour diner providing a full range of breakfast and dinner options at all hours of the night.
cards.evidence_claim: The Denny's located at 4330 Fox Valley Center Dr in Aurora is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
cards.source_title: Denny's 4330 FOX VALLEY CENTER DR RESTAURANT

cards.title: Dunkin' on Farnsworth
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Coffee and Donuts
cards.notes: Fuel up with coffee and donuts at this 24-hour location. It serves as a reliable stop for students pulling all-nighters during finals week.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour coffee and bakery shop located on Farnsworth Avenue, providing caffeine and snacks around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dunkin' at 1255 N Farnsworth Ave in Aurora is documented as being open 24 hours a day.
cards.source_title: Dunkin' at 1255 N Farnsworth Ave in Aurora

cards.title: Steak 'n Shake
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Shakes and Burgers
cards.notes: Visit for hand-dipped milkshakes and steakburgers. The extended weekend hours make it a popular destination for students after campus events.
cards.short_summary: A casual restaurant known for its milkshakes and burgers, offering late-night service until midnight on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: The Steak 'n Shake at 4333 Fox Valley Center Dr is open until 12:00 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM on Fridays and Saturdays; 10:00 PM on other days.

cards.title: 7-Eleven
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Convenience Run
cards.notes: Grab quick snacks, drinks, or hot food items at any time. This convenience store is a go-to for essential supplies during late-night study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 convenience store offering a variety of grab-and-go food options and beverages.
cards.evidence_claim: The 7-Eleven at 1790 Farnsworth Ave in Aurora is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

cards.title: IHOP
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Pancake House
cards.notes: Enjoy breakfast for dinner at this nearby pancake house. It provides a sit-down environment for students looking to decompress late at night.
cards.short_summary: A well-known breakfast chain offering pancakes and other diner staples with late-night operating hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The IHOP in Aurora is listed as a location for late-night dining, with many locations typically operating 24 hours or until very late.
cards.source_title: IHOP® Restaurant Locations in Aurora, IL
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by location; typically open late or 24 hours.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies Delivery
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Cookie Delivery to Campus
cards.notes: Order warm cookies directly to your dorm or library. This service is specifically designed for the late-night college demographic.
cards.short_summary: A bakery specializing in late-night cookie delivery, serving the Aurora University area from nearby Naperville.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies offers delivery to Aurora, IL, with service hours extending until 1:00 AM or later.
cards.access_notes: Delivery available until 1:00 AM or later depending on the day.

cards.title: Late Night Breakfast at Tru Blu
cards.subtitle: Seasonal Campus Tradition
cards.notes: Attend the Late Night Breakfast event during finals week. It is a university-sponsored tradition held in the main dining hall to support students.
cards.short_summary: A recurring university event held at Tru Blu Dining, offering late-night meals during peak academic periods.
cards.evidence_claim: Aurora University hosts 'Late Night Breakfast' events at Tru Blu Dining, typically from 9:00 PM to 11:00 PM during finals week.
cards.access_notes: Event-based; typically 9:00 PM - 11:00 PM during finals week.
